data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 integrates the thermal-storage mechanism of SRC_003 with the sky-view-factor (SVF) trapping mechanism of SRC_005, proposing that nocturnal UHI is a coupled two-stage process: stored sensible heat release supplies the excess energy while low-SVF canyon geometry retards its radiative dissipation. This integrated claim is REFUTED IF the cross-city UHI magnitude can be fully predicted by either built density alone (which collapses the storage and SVF effects into one indistinguishable variable) or by vegetation fraction alone (which would make latent-heat deficit, per SRC_002, the sufficient single predictor, rendering the integrated thermal-SVF model redundant).
